title: 第11章 斩断因果，玄內霸体
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
姜长生精心为蛇蛋做了一个小窝，就在床榻上，由被褥环绕而成，自打修仙起，他几乎没有睡过觉，深夜都是静坐纳气，取代睡眠，天亮之后精神奕奕。
他开始期待蛇蛋的孵化，每日都会往蛋内注入灵力，滋养蛇胎。
平静的日子在半个月后打破。
“在下柳洛姻，听闻长生道长击毙邪魔鬼目邪王，特来拜访。”
一道清冷的声音从屋外传来，姜长生睁开眼睛，他早就察觉到对方向自己的房屋寻来，只是对方威胁不到他，他便没有出声询问。
姜长生的声音飘出去：“不知柳姑娘找我所为何事？”
庭院之中，白雪皑皑，雪地里立着一女子，她身穿秀丽紫衣，一副江湖侠客的打扮，手握一把宝剑，面容虽俏美，但眉宇间透着一股冰冷杀意，拒人于千里之外。
柳洛姻开口道：“我年幼之时，邪王屠我全家，我自幼漂泊，习得一身武艺，本想找邪王复仇，但听闻他被长生道长击毙，我想请长生道长赐教，无论胜负，从此以后这桩恩怨便了去，他日，若是道长需要我相助，我定出手。”
姜长生愣了愣，怀疑自己听错了。
什么鬼？
我帮你报仇了，你找我切磋了因果？
姜长生回答道：“抱歉，我不喜与人切磋，我乃修道之人，习武只是我的一点爱好罢了，姑娘请回吧，至于人情，不必念着。”
幸好鬼目邪王被他杀了，否则这傻姑娘找上鬼目邪王必死无疑。
两者的真气程度还是有差距的，虽然差距不大，但两人还有年龄差距，这意味着经验差距。
柳洛姻突然跪在雪地上，她面无表情道：“若是道长不答应，那我便长跪于此，直到饿死，死在贵观内。”
话音落下，庭院内陷入寂静之中，连风雪之声也消失了。
后方不远处，青苦见到这一幕皱眉，他正要上前阻拦，房门
快十七岁的姜长生已经长开，身形挺拔，面容俊逸，腰间佩着太行剑，手中握着麒麟拂尘，柳洛姻下意识抬头，目光落在姜长生身上，她不由愣住。
四目相对，山上的风雪好似也停下来。
姜长生皱眉问道：“姑娘，何必胡搅蛮缠，好歹我也算帮了你。”

柳洛姻收回目光，脸颊微红，站起身来，道：“我知晓，我并非不感恩，我定然也不是你的对手，我只是想了却我的一桩心事，道长纵然伤到我，我也不会有怨言，来日定当回报。”
姜长生的眉头皱得更紧。
柳洛姻直接拔剑，等待着姜长生出手。
姜长生叹息一声，道：“那就出手吧，拿出全力来，以免日后心有不甘。”
柳洛姻一听，嘴角上扬，当即纵身跃起，右手快速挥剑，一道道剑气以肉眼可见的形态杀向姜长生，撕裂风雪。
这时，柳洛姻突然感觉到一切变得缓慢，她看着姜长生抬腿，动作不快，但给她一种不可阻挡的气势。
姜长生抬起左腿踢去，数十腿影撞散半空中的剑气，击中柳洛姻。
“噗——”
柳洛姻吐血倒飞出去，重重的摔在雪堆里。
她痛苦的捂着胸口，想要站起来，但又吐了一口血，直接晕倒过去。
青苦吓得立即跑过来，颤声问道：“师兄，她……”
姜长生缓缓收腿，摇头失笑道：“没死，带下去吧。”
在京城杀人是犯法的，除非对方是鬼目邪王那种死囚，或者自卫。
青苦松了一口气，刚蹲下又站起身来，道：“不行，我去叫师姐。”
说完，他便跑出去。
姜长生转身回屋，留下柳洛姻在雪堆里。
没多久，大师姐孟秋霜与青苦带着数名弟子前来，将柳洛姻带走，此事迅速传开，弟子们广为流传，对姜长生有了更深的认知。
这位师兄独居后变凶了！
姜长生并没有重创柳洛姻，只是震荡了真气，没有伤及五脏六腑，数日便能康复，之所以这般做，他是怕柳洛姻纠缠不休，直接让她绝望，断了念想。
三日后，柳洛姻便下了山，并没有再来找姜长生。

【开元十七年，江湖女子柳洛姻因仇怨找你切磋，你击溃其念想，你度过了一场因果，获得生存奖励——武学‘玄內霸体’】
这也算磨难？
看来若是下手没有这么狠，我岂不是要与她有更多的瓜葛？
姜长生脑补了很多可能，但他一点也不后悔，世间女子何其多，在修道的路上可不能分心，百年之后，对方不过是一片黄土，无需惦记。
“这一生注定是孤独的。”
姜长生感慨一声，然后美滋滋的传承玄內霸体。
玄內霸体，算是内家武学，以真气淬体，可坚如刚铁，刀剑难刺，百毒不侵，听起来倒是很牛逼，姜长生打算每日抽两个时辰练练。
道法自然功突破第四层后便进入了平缓的增长期，距离突破第五层遥遥无期，不过他还年轻，慢慢来便是。
他如今的灵力已经可以用磅礴来形容，清虚道长的那点灵气与他相比，如同小溪比汪洋，米粒之光与皓月争辉。
只是不知与皇宫的那位通天境强者相比，孰强孰弱。
冬雪消融，开元十七年的春季到来，姜长生也悄然度过十七岁生日。
十七岁，在景朝已经是成年人，在二十年前，战场上多的是十六七岁的少年。
庭院内，姜长生打坐在水缸之上，仔细看去，他的双腿、屁股距离水面有三四公分的空隙，他是飘浮在空中，只是从远处看去，他坐在水面上。
他的道袍鼓动不停，肉眼可见的热气从毛孔里溢出来，显露出的皮肤好似炒豆一般跳动，颇为惊悚。
他忽然起身，落在水缸旁边，皮肤迅速恢复如初，道袍也被蒸干。
过了十数息时间，院子里的木门被推开，青苦走进来，一脸兴奋。
这么多年过去，闯荡江湖的经历已经被他放下，他不再那么沉默寡言，又恢复年少时的活泼，自从习得九寻天龙步后，他的武艺突飞猛进，在弟子之中不说出类拔萃，排在前十也是没问题的。
当然，整个龙起观的武艺都很差，绝大多数只会拳脚功夫，清虚道长的真气相当于真元境，或许能展现出灵识境的实力，大师姐孟秋霜则是一流高手的水平。
很菜，不过好在位于京城，没有那么多武林竞争。
“师兄，喜讯啊，秋河师兄考上了武状元，还与朝堂三品大官结为亲家，风光极了，大师姐准备带数位弟子去拜访他，你去吗？”

青苦兴奋道，对于孟秋河，他还是很敬重的，孟秋河虽叛出龙起观，但一直待在京城，每当弟子下山碰见他，都会被他请客，仿佛依旧是师兄弟。
姜长生摇头笑道：“我就不去了，你们去吧。”
青苦道：“去的话可以吃好吃的，有荤菜啊。”
龙起观虽然没有戒荤的习俗，但平日里山上只有蔬菜、果实，弟子又没有钱财，下山也很难吃肉，所以听闻要去拜访孟秋河，都很兴奋，争着要去。
姜长生依旧拒绝，青苦只能放弃，他也怕耽误时间，蹭不上佳肴。
“他怎么考上的武状元？”
姜长生望着青苦的背影，默默想到。
孟秋河的武功他知道，在他眼里很一般，这才下山多久？
陈礼说过，武状元几乎都是江湖高手在争夺，之前甚至出现过绝顶高手夺得武状元，直接参军当将领，建功立业，引起更多的武林高手参加武科举。
有点猫腻。
姜长生摇了摇头，继续练功，争取早日将玄內霸体练至大成。
夜幕降临。
姜长生回到屋内，他正在观测蛇蛋，这小家伙啥时候才出来？
【开元十七年，你曾经的师兄孟秋河设局想要算计你，然而你没有去，躲过一劫，你获得生存奖励——法术‘回春术’】
姜长生看到这行字不由皱眉，孟秋河投敌了？
怪不得他能成为武状元。
虽然有些愤慨，但他更多的是兴奋。
又有法术了！
这才像话，修仙者岂能一直习武？
其实像这样的小磨难多点也挺好，能让他变得更强。

姜长生立即传承回春术，记忆涌入他的脑海里。
回春术是一种急救法术，人若是刚死，可助其吊一口气，再活一段时间，平时，回春术就只能治愈伤口，加快血液凝固。
吊一口气？
这可是神术啊！
姜长生觉得自己可以去断案了。
这一夜，姜长生都在修行回春术，青苦没有再来找他，孟秋河只是想算计他，自然没有为难自己的亲妹妹与其他弟子。
一个月后，姜长生彻底掌握回春术，但玄內霸体还未大成，还需要花时间。
蛇蛋仍未孵化，若非能感受到里面的生气，姜长生都想扔了，或者炒个蛋吃。
这一日，姜长生正在练功，青苦前来拜访，神情气愤。
“长生师兄，有人挑衅龙起观，弟子们皆不是其对手，对方扬言龙起观不配为京城唯一的武林门派，要取代我们！”
青苦愤怒至极，唯一的拳头紧握，青筋暴起。
姜长生皱眉问道：“京城之中，还有人敢挑衅龙起观？”
青苦咬牙道：“对方乃是陛下器重的妖道，想要在京城内开道观，可城内就龙起山这一座山。”
content_en:
Jiang Changsheng carefully made a small nest for the snake egg, which was on the bed and surrounded by quilts. Since he began to cultivate as an immortal, he had hardly slept. He would sit quietly and breathe in his energy late at night instead of sleeping. After dawn, he would be full of energy.
He began to look forward to the hatching of the snake eggs, and would inject spiritual power into the eggs every day to nourish the snake fetuses.
The peaceful days were broken half a month later.
"I'm Liu Luoyin. I heard that Taoist Priest Changsheng killed the evil demon King Mumu, so I came here to visit you."
A cold voice came from outside the house. Jiang Changsheng opened his eyes. He had long noticed that the other party was looking for his house, but the other party could not threaten him, so he did not ask.
Jiang Changsheng's voice floated out: "I wonder why Miss Liu wants to see me?"
In the courtyard, covered with white snow, stood a woman in the snow. She was dressed in beautiful purple clothes and dressed like a knight-errant. She held a sword in her hand. Although her face was pretty, there was a cold murderous intention between her eyebrows, which kept people away from thousands of miles away.
Liu Luoyin said: "When I was young, the evil king slaughtered my whole family. I have been wandering since I was a child. I have learned martial arts. I originally wanted to seek revenge from the evil king, but I heard that he was killed by the Taoist Changsheng. I want to ask the Taoist Changsheng to teach me. Regardless of victory or defeat, this grudge will be over from now on. If the Taoist needs my help in the future, I will definitely take action."
Jiang Changsheng was stunned for a moment, suspecting that he heard wrongly.
What the hell?
I helped you get revenge, and you came to me to discuss cause and effect?
Jiang Changsheng replied: "I'm sorry, I don't like to compete with others. I am a Taoist, and practicing martial arts is just a hobby of mine. Please go back, girl. As for favors, don't worry about it."
Fortunately, the Ghost Eye Evil King was killed by him, otherwise this silly girl would definitely die if she found the Ghost Eye Evil King.
There is still a gap in the level of Qi between the two. Although the gap is not big, there is still an age gap between the two, which means a gap in experience.
Liu Luoyin suddenly knelt on the snow. She said expressionlessly: "If the Taoist master doesn't agree, then I will kneel here until I starve to death in Guiguan."
As soon as the words fell, the courtyard fell into silence, and even the sound of the wind and snow disappeared.
Not far behind, Qing Ku frowned when he saw this scene. He was about to step forward to stop him, when the door
Jiang Changsheng, who was almost seventeen years old, had grown taller and taller, with a handsome face. He had a Taihang sword on his waist and a unicorn fly whisk in his hand. Liu Luoin subconsciously raised her head and her eyes fell on Jiang Changsheng. She couldn't help but be stunned.
Their eyes met, and the wind and snow on the mountain seemed to have stopped.
Jiang Changsheng frowned and asked, "Girl, why bother with this? At least I've helped you."
Liu Luoyin looked away, her cheeks turned red, and she stood up and said, "I know, I'm not ungrateful, and I'm certainly no match for you. I just wanted to put an end to something on my mind. Even if Taoist Master hurts me, I won't complain, and I will repay you in the future."
Jiang Changsheng's brows furrowed even more.
Liu Luoyin drew his sword directly and waited for Jiang Changsheng to take action.
Jiang Changsheng sighed and said: "Then take action and use all your strength to avoid feeling unwilling in the future."
When Liu Luoyin heard this, the corner of his mouth raised, and he immediately jumped up and swung his sword quickly with his right hand. The sword energy struck Jiang Changsheng in a form visible to the naked eye, tearing the wind and snow apart.
At this time, Liu Luoyin suddenly felt that everything was slowing down. She watched Jiang Changsheng lift his legs. The movement was not fast, but it gave her an unstoppable momentum.
Jiang Changsheng raised his left leg and kicked it. The shadows of dozens of legs scattered the sword energy in the air and hit Liu Luoyin.
"Pfft——"
Liu Luoyin vomited blood and flew backwards, falling heavily into the snow.
She clutched her chest in pain and tried to stand up, but she vomited a mouthful of blood and fainted.
Qing Ku was so frightened that he immediately ran over and asked in a trembling voice: "Brother, she..."
Jiang Changsheng slowly retracted his legs, shook his head and said with a smile: "He's not dead, take him down."
It is illegal to kill someone in the capital, unless the other person is a death row prisoner like Ghost Eye Evil King, or is acting in self-defense.
Qing Ku breathed a sigh of relief and stood up again just as he squatted down.Said: "No, I'll call Senior Sister."
After saying that, he ran out.
Jiang Changsheng turned around and went back to the house, leaving Liu Luoyin in the snowdrift.
Not long after, senior sisters Meng Qiu Shuang and Qing Ku came with several disciples and took Liu Luoyin away. This matter spread quickly, and the disciples spread the news widely and gained a deeper understanding of Jiang Changsheng.
This senior brother became vicious after living alone!
Jiang Changsheng did not severely injure Liu Luoyin, but only shocked her vitality, without damaging her internal organs. He could recover in a few days. The reason why he did this was because he was afraid that Liu Luoyin would be entangled with her, which would directly make her despair and give up her thoughts.
Three days later, Liu Luoyin went down the mountain and did not look for Jiang Changsheng again.
[In the 17th year of Kaiyuan, Liu Luoqiu, a woman from the Jianghu community, came to you for discussion due to grudges. You defeated her thoughts. You survived the cause and effect and received the survival reward - the martial arts ‘Xuan Nei Hegemon Body’]
Is this considered a hardship?
It seems that if the attack was not so ruthless, wouldn't I have more to do with her?
Jiang Changsheng thought about many possibilities, but he did not regret it at all. There were so many women in the world, and he could not be distracted on the road of spiritual cultivation. After a hundred years, the other party would be nothing more than a piece of loess, and there was no need to worry about it.
"This life is destined to be lonely."
Jiang Changsheng sighed with emotion, and then proudly inherited the Xuan Nei Hegemony.
Xuan Nei Ba Ti is considered an internal martial arts. The body is tempered with true energy and is as strong as iron. It is difficult to stab with swords and is invulnerable to all poisons. It sounds very impressive. Jiang Changsheng plans to practice it for two hours every day.
After breaking through the fourth level of Taoist natural skills, he entered a period of gentle growth. He was still far away from breaking through the fifth level. However, he was still young, so he just had to take his time.
His current spiritual power can be described as majestic. Compared with him, the spiritual energy of Taoist Master Qingxu is like a stream compared with the vast ocean, and the light of a grain of rice competes with the bright moon.
I just don’t know who is stronger or weaker compared to the powerful man in the Tongtian Realm in the palace.
The winter snow melted, spring arrived in the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan, and Jiang Changsheng also quietly celebrated his seventeenth birthday.
At the age of seventeen, he was already an adult in Jing Dynasty. Twenty years ago, there were more teenagers aged sixteen or seventeen on the battlefield.
In the courtyard, Jiang Changsheng was meditating on a water tank. If you look closely, you can see that there is a gap of three or four centimeters between his legs and buttocks. He is floating in the air, but from a distance, he is sitting on the water.
His robes were beating incessantly, heat visible to the naked eye overflowed from his pores, and the exposed skin was beating like fried beans, which was quite terrifying.
He suddenly stood up and landed next to the water tank. His skin quickly returned to its original state, and his robes were evaporated dry.
After more than ten breaths, the wooden door in the yard was pushed open, and Qing Ku walked in with an excited look on his face.
After so many years, he has put aside the experience of wandering in the world. He is no longer so taciturn, and has returned to the liveliness of his youth. Since he learned the Nine-Xun Tianlong Step, his martial arts have improved by leaps and bounds. Among his disciples, he is not said to be outstanding, and there is no problem in ranking in the top ten.
Of course, the martial arts skills of the entire Long Qiguan are very poor, and most of them only know fists and kicks. Taoist Master Qingxu's Qi is equivalent to the True Yuan Realm, and may be able to show the strength of the Spiritual Consciousness Realm. Senior Sister Meng Qiu Shuang is at the level of a first-class master.
It's pretty cool, but fortunately it's located in the capital, so there isn't that much competition in the martial arts world.
"Senior brother, great news. Senior brother Qiuhe has been admitted to the martial arts championship, and has also married a third-rank official in the court. It is a great sight. Senior sister is going to bring several disciples to visit him. Will you go?"
Qing Ku said excitedly that he still respected Meng Qiuhe very much. Although Meng Qiuhe defected from Longqi Temple, he still stayed in the capital. Whenever his disciples went down the mountain and met him, they would be treated by him, as if they were still senior brothers.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and smiled: "I won't go, you can go."
Qing Ku said: "If you go, you can eat delicious food, including meat dishes."
Although Longqi Temple does not have the custom of abstaining from meat, there are only vegetables and fruits on the mountain on weekdays. Since the disciples have no money, it is difficult to eat meat when they go down the mountain, so I heard that I want to visitMeng Qiuhe was very excited and eager to go.
Jiang Changsheng still refused, so Qingku had no choice but to give up. He was also afraid of wasting time and missing out on delicious food.
"How did he pass the imperial examination?"
Jiang Changsheng looked at Qing Ku's back and thought silently.
He knew that Meng Qiuhe's martial arts was average in his eyes. How long had it been since he had been down the mountain?
Chen Li said that almost all martial arts masters compete for the top spot in martial arts. In the past, there were even top masters who won the top spot in martial arts and directly joined the army as generals and made great achievements, which attracted more martial arts masters to participate in the martial arts examination.
A bit fishy.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and continued to practice, striving to reach perfection in the Xuan Nei Hegemony Body as soon as possible.
Night falls.
Jiang Changsheng returned to the house. He was observing the snake eggs. When will this little guy come out?
[In the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan, your former senior brother Meng Qiuhe set up a trap to plot against you, but you did not go and escaped. You received a survival reward - the spell 'Rejuvenation']
Jiang Changsheng couldn't help but frown when he saw this line of writing. Meng Qiuhe surrendered to the enemy?
No wonder he became the top scholar in martial arts.
Although he was a little indignant, he was more excited.
There's another spell!
This is ridiculous. How can a cultivator continue to practice martial arts?
In fact, it would be good to have more small hardships like this, which can make him stronger.
Jiang Changsheng immediately passed on the rejuvenation technique, and memories poured into his mind.
Rejuvenation is a first-aid spell. If a person has just died, it can help him breathe a sigh of relief and live for a while. Normally, rejuvenation can only heal wounds and speed up blood coagulation.
Take a breath?
This is divine magic!
Jiang Changsheng felt that he could solve the case.
That night, Jiang Changsheng was practicing the rejuvenation technique. Qing Ku did not come to him again. Meng Qiuhe just wanted to plot against him, so he naturally did not embarrass his sister or other disciples.
A month later, Jiang Changsheng completely mastered the rejuvenation technique, but the Xuan Nei Hegemony had not yet been fully developed and it would take time.
The snake eggs have not hatched yet. If he could not feel the life inside, Jiang Changsheng would have thrown them away or scrambled eggs to eat.
On this day, Jiang Changsheng was practicing Kung Fu, and Qing Ku came to visit, looking angry.
"Senior Brother Changsheng, someone is provoking Long Qiguan. None of the disciples are his match. The other party threatens that Long Qiguan is not worthy of being the only martial arts sect in the capital and wants to replace us!"
Qing Ku was so angry that his only fist was clenched and veins popped out.
Jiang Changsheng frowned and asked, "Is there anyone in the capital who dares to challenge Long Qiguan?"
Qing Ku gritted his teeth and said, "The opponent is a demon Taoist whom Your Majesty values highly. He wants to open a Taoist temple in the capital, but the only mountain in the city is Longqi Mountain."
